name: Optimal Extraction via Partition Index
definition: An algorithm that extracts only the tetrahedra actually intersected by the level set by partitioning the mesh along saddle contours and using a partition index to find seed vertices.
summary: Optimal Extraction via Partition Index extracts isosurfaces by pre-processing meshes into partitions separated by saddle contours, enabling direct jumps to intersected tetrahedra for optimal runtime.
